{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_counts = data[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Display the number of patients with duplicates and their sample_seq values
print(f"Total patients with duplicate IDs: {len(duplicate_counts)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs and their sample_seq values:\n{duplicate_counts}")"}
